SSS71.name: 前尘鳉
SSS71.form: a small elongated body with a flattened top, a broad rounded head, an upturned mouth, no lateral line
SSS71.fins: a long dorsal fin, a rounded tail fin, short pectoral fins
SSS71.markings: a band of scattered dust-like specks along the flank

SSS72.name: 后时鰕虎
SSS72.form: a small stout body, a large blunt head, a wide mouth, fused pelvic fins forming a disc, no lateral line
SSS72.fins: two dorsal fins, a rounded tail fin, fused pelvic fins forming a sucking disc
SSS72.markings: a few faint vertical bands along the flank, a single ring near the tail base

SSS73.name: 拾光鲹
SSS73.form: a streamlined spindle body with a keeled belly, a small pointed head, a terminal mouth
SSS73.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of finlets behind the dorsal and anal fins
SSS73.markings: a row of luminous pores along the flank, a single bright node behind the eye

SSS74.name: 逆旅鲽
SSS74.form: a flattened oval body, both eyes on one side, a small twisted mouth, a thin wavy fin margin
SSS74.fins: a long dorsal fin along the upper edge, an anal fin along the lower edge, a rounded tail fin
SSS74.markings: an irregular mosaic of worn patches, a single line across the tail base

SSS75.name: 流年鲻
SSS75.form: an elongated rounded body, a broad flat head, a small terminal mouth, a short caudal peduncle
SSS75.fins: two separate dorsal fins, a forked tail fin, long pectoral fins
SSS75.markings: faint longitudinal lines along the flank, a row of thin rings near the gill cover

SSS76.name: 空洞鳕
SSS76.form: an elongated body with a slightly arched back, a moderate head, a small chin barbel, a clear lateral line
SSS76.fins: three dorsal fins, two anal fins, a slightly forked tail fin
SSS76.markings: a hollow oval gap on each flank, a sparse line of dots above the lateral line

SSS77.name: 寂时鲹
SSS77.form: a streamlined spindle body with a keeled belly, a small head, a high-set eye, a short snout
SSS77.fins: a long low dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, a row of finlets
SSS77.markings: a single stilled wave line along the flank, a faint ring near the tail base

SSS78.name: 时间鲟
SSS78.form: an elongated body with five rows of bony scutes along the back and flanks, a long flattened snout, a small inferior mouth, four barbels before the mouth
SSS78.fins: a dorsal fin set far back, a tail fin with a long upper lobe, small pectoral fins
SSS78.markings: even rows of scute plates along the body, a single line of dots near the gill cover

SSS79.name: 溯流皇带
SSS79.form: a narrow ribbon-like body, a small upturned head, a fan crest of soft rays on the nape, a chain of eroded ring segments
SSS79.fins: a continuous dorsal crest along the back, long oar-like pelvic fins, a tiny tail fin
SSS79.markings: broken ring segments along the flank, a single stilled ripple behind the gill cover

SSS80.name: 逆熵鳐
SSS80.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with angular facet edges, a short blunt snout, a long thin tail with a single spine
SSS80.fins: broad wing-like pectoral fins with crisp corners, a small dorsal fin near the tail base
SSS80.markings: a spiral line coiling across the disc, a single ring at the center of the back
